offering_description.value: Develops, manufactures and sells generic, specialty and biosimilar pharmaceuticals, mainly in the US, to wholesalers, retailers, hospitals and institutions. Also distributes third-party specialty drugs and makes products in its own plants.

primary_products.value: generic prescription drugs; specialty branded pharmaceuticals; biosimilars; injectables; complex generics

customer_segment.value: B2B: drug wholesalers, retail pharmacy chains, hospitals, group purchasing organizations, institutional buyers; B2G: government agencies buying through institutional distribution

end_markets.value: healthcare; pharmaceuticals; neurology; oncology supportive care; hospital care

revenue_model.value: product sales: generic, specialty and biosimilar drugs sold to wholesalers, pharmacies and hospitals

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures drugs from purchased active ingredients and excipients, sold to wholesalers and pharmacies; distributor: distributes third-party pharmaceuticals to government and institutional customers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States, also India, Europe and other international markets, with plants in US and India

specialization.value: related lines: generics, specialty branded drugs, biosimilars and pharmaceutical distribution

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: major national drug wholesalers; third-party retail: retail pharmacy chains and mail-order pharmacies; direct sales: hospitals, group purchasing organizations and government customers
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: drug approval and manufacturing compliance under FDA, DEA and international regulators
